problem: The equation W = 1200 - 35t models the volume W, in gallons, of water remaining in a tank t minutes after a pump begins draining the tank. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 35 in this context?
choices: The tank contained 35 gallons of water when the pump began draining it.
The pump drains 35 gallons of water from the tank each minute.
The pump takes 35 minutes to drain the tank completely.
The volume of water in the tank decreases by 35% each minute.
correctAnswer: The pump drains 35 gallons of water from the tank each minute.

bad.why: Graphing the line shows its shape but not what 35 means; the interpretation is still left to the student, so the rows add work without answering.
The intercepts (0, 1200) and (34.3, 0) describe the starting volume and the empty time, not the meaning of 35; they can at best eliminate choices.
There is no data to fit; the model is already given, and the question asks for meaning, not a number.

algebraFirst.description: Identifies 35 as the slope of the linear model and recalls that slope is the change in W per one-minute increase in t; sometimes graphs the line first, which adds nothing.

explanationNotes: Explain in plain words that 35 multiplies t, so every extra minute subtracts another 35 gallons: it is a rate in gallons per minute, not a starting amount (that is 1200), a total time, or a percent.
